paper.arxiv.2607.11192

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2607.11192v3. Professional PDF task/rubric construction and adversarially selected workload limits establish evaluation protocol scope. Judge/provider-native-PDF handling and underlying rights remain bounded. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Every retained item was selected because at least two frontier models failed it at collection time. The authors explicitly caution that absolute pass rates therefore describe adversarially selected professional tasks rather than professional document work at large; the live leaderboard also evolves beyond this frozen July 2026 snapshot.

Permanent record ID: repair.qualbinding.20261111.v1.mandatory3.claim.arxiv.2607.11192.limitation

  • This is a source-specific, first-party description; this repair does not independently reproduce experiments or audit operational execution and customer outcomes.
  • Working professionals submit original PDFs, questions and reference answers. Experts write atomic rubric criteria and sanity-check good/bad outputs; retention requires major errors from at least two frontier models.
  • Gemini 3.5 Flash judges criteria separately without source PDF or gold answer and is calibrated to expert raters according to the authors. Discussed failures are hand-checked; the judge family also appears among evaluated models.
  • One hundred selected items span ten domains. Each item is run five times per model with native provider PDF input and no tools/additional context; provider document handling is part of the measured protocol.
  • Table 6 is a July 2026 seventeen-model snapshot. The authors distinguish adversarially selected task performance from professional document work at large; the live leaderboard evolves.
  • Table 2 declares the released benchmark Apache 2.0 while third-party PDFs retain original rights; benchmark licensing is not blanket PDF redistribution permission.
  • This author did not independently audit judge calibration, individual items or underlying PDF rights and does not infer unsupervised-use readiness.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

GDP.pdf retains 100 expert-authored question/PDF tasks across ten professional domains after at least two frontier models make material errors. Experts write atomic rubric criteria; each criterion is judged separately by Gemini 3.5 Flash without the source PDF or reference answer. Strict pass requires every criterion, while mean rubric score gives partial credit.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The July 2026 snapshot reports 2–30.7% strict pass rates across 17 listed models on 100 items, averaging five runs per model with native PDF input and no tools/additional context. These are all-criteria item pass rates on this selected suite, not document-work success rates in general.
